svg.title: Attention tuning knob sweeps, M5 Pro
svg.text: Attention tuning knobs — speed relative to the best value
Cell = best median time / this value’s median time; 1.00 is the winner, lower is slower. Median ms over 5 rounds.
Dispatch split: per-call time at batched = 1 / at batched = 32 (blue: batching 32 is faster per call)
